detailed_description:
The target video is exactly 15 seconds long in a cinematic vertical 9:16 format. Use a clean pale-blue and white science-fiction visual style, smooth controlled camera movement, luminous translucent materials, volumetric light, reflective surfaces, and high contrast between the opening darkness and the glowing energy. No dialogue, no voice-over, no subtitles, no captions, and no on-screen text.

[Shot 1] The video opens on a completely black screen with no visible environment. At the exact center, a tiny pale-blue point of light slowly appears. It flickers once, then becomes brighter and more concentrated. A faint circular glow forms around it while the rest of the frame remains completely black. The point begins to expand rapidly, leaving a soft blue trail and revealing the first sharp edges of a geometric crystal.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the pale-blue point rapidly transforms into a huge floating diamond-shaped energy block, <Subject 3>. The block is translucent and faceted, with bright internal light, thin luminous geometric lines, and delicate energy rings orbiting around it. The camera pulls back to reveal <Subject 2> floating in front of the enormous diamond, seen from behind in a full-body composition. Her long blonde hair and pink plush hooded onesie drift gently as if suspended in zero gravity. She remains centered in front of the energy block while small particles drift around both of them.

[Shot 3] At 00:05.500, the shot cuts to a close-up of <Subject 2>'s face. She slowly tilts her head upward, eyes wide with quiet curiosity, watching the glowing diamond above her. Pale-blue light reflects across her eyes, cheeks, and the edge of her pink hood. Her expression is fascinated and cautious, with subtle breathing and gentle hair movement. The background is heavily blurred, leaving only the luminous shape and floating particles visible behind her.

[Shot 4] At 00:07.500, the shot cuts to an extreme close-up of <Subject 2>'s hand and index finger. She slowly reaches forward and lightly touches one sharp facet of <Subject 3>. The instant her fingertip makes contact, a bright energy ripple spreads across the entire diamond. The orbiting rings accelerate briefly, the internal light intensifies, and the energy block releases a powerful pale-blue flash. From 00:09.000 to 00:10.000, the flash expands outward until it fills the entire frame with glowing white-blue light.

[Shot 5] At 00:10.000, the light begins to fade and resolves into <Subject 1>, matching the futuristic geometric environment and composition of <Picture 1>. The camera faces down the symmetrical chamber toward the central diamond energy block. Translucent cubic structures line both sides, glowing white grid lines extend across the reflective floor, and tiny particles float in the blue atmosphere. The diamond energy block remains suspended exactly at the center and slowly rotates in place around its vertical axis. Soft volumetric rays pass through the space while the camera makes a very slow forward movement toward the rotating energy block. Hold the final composition until 00:15.000.
